input.summary: Condition RevMed's Change of Control assignment on Sanofi's consent (not unreasonably withheld) and bar assignment to a Sanofi competitor.
input.comment: [Playbook] We are comfortable with Sanofi's affiliate and M&A assignment rights, but our position is that RevMed may not assign without our consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, and never to a competitor of Sanofi. We have therefore split Section 15.2(a)(ii) so RevMed's Change of Control assignment is consent-gated and added an express competitor bar; Sanofi's prong is unchanged.

ops.oldText: Either Party may, without consent of the other Party, assign this Agreement in whole to (i) in the case of RevMed, its successor in interest or assignee or purchaser, as applicable, in the case of a Change of Control or (ii) in the case of Sanofi, its successor in interest or assignee or purchaser, as applicable, in connection with the sale of all or substantially all of its assets to which this Agreement relates, or in connection with a merger, acquisition or similar transaction.
ops.newText: Sanofi may, without consent of RevMed, assign this Agreement in whole to its successor in interest or assignee or purchaser, as applicable, in connection with the sale of all or substantially all of its assets to which this Agreement relates, or in connection with a merger, acquisition or similar transaction, and RevMed may, with the consent of Sanofi (not to be unreasonably withheld), assign this Agreement in whole to its successor in interest or assignee or purchaser, as applicable, in the case of a Change of Control. In no event shall RevMed assign this Agreement or any rights or obligations hereunder to a competitor of Sanofi.
